panels.title: Modules delivered
panels.description: Module-languages with a manifest artifact. package_task is the only thing that writes one, so this counts completed deliveries rather than started ones.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as "delivered" from artifacts where kind = 'manifest';

panels.title: Localization throughput (segments approved per day)
panels.description: Reviewer output, which is the pipeline's real rate limit: machine stages are fast and the human gate is not.

targets.rawSql: select date_trunc('day', created_at) as time, language as metric, count(*) as value from localizations where stage = 'approved' and $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1, 2 order by 1;

panels.title: Spend per module-language (INR / USD)
panels.description: Summed from adapter_calls, which every vendor call writes through platform/adapters/runtime.py using platform/config/pricing.yaml. NOTE: adapter_calls carries session_id, not module_id, so this is grouped by vendor and capability until uc2 threads a module-scoped session id through the Celery tasks — see the uc2/P5 report.

targets.rawSql: select vendor, capability, model, count(*) as calls, round(sum(cost_inr), 2) as inr, round(sum(cost_usd), 4) as usd from adapter_calls where $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1, 2, 3 order by inr desc;

panels.title: Comprehension: native vs English-only control
panels.description: PRD B6's business metric. Cells with fewer than 5 attempts show their count and a null rate; the API applies the same rule, so the dashboard and the report agree.

targets.rawSql: select cohort, language, count(*) as attempts, case when count(*) >= 5 then round(avg(case when score::numeric / nullif(max_score, 0) >= 0.6 then 1 else 0 end), 3) end as pass_rate, round(avg(score::numeric / nullif(max_score, 0)), 3) as mean_score, round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by duration_ms) / 1000.0, 1) as median_seconds from quiz_attempts where $__timeFilter(taken_at) group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2;

panels.title: Segments awaiting review
panels.description: post_edit rows with no approved row yet: what the reviewers still owe.

targets.rawSql: select m.title, p.language, count(*) as awaiting from localizations p join modules m on m.id = p.module_id where p.stage = 'post_edit' and not exists (select 1 from localizations a where a.module_id = p.module_id and a.seg_id = p.seg_id and a.language = p.language and a.stage = 'approved') group by 1, 2 order by awaiting desc;
